summary.name: Picsart AI Image Generator
summary.one_liner: A web-based text-to-image generator from Picsart that lets you create images from prompts using 65 AI models.
use_cases: generate images from a text prompt
create SVG logos and icons from a prompt
convert a raster image into SVG
edit or transform an uploaded image with a prompt
summary.what_it_does: Picsart's AI Image Generator turns text prompts into images, offering access to 65 AI image models that the page describes as tuned for photorealism, illustration, typography, or speed. Users can pick a model, apply built-in style presets, and generate images in full screen. The page says outputs can be high resolution up to 8K. Some listed models support reference-image input, editing with masks, and vector (SVG) output, and Ideogram Vectorize converts JPEG, PNG or WebP images into SVG. Users can also describe how to transform an uploaded image.
notable: Access to 65 AI image models from one interface
Built-in style presets applied from the first prompt
Vector (SVG) output via Ideogram Vector and Vectorize models
Output up to 8K resolution according to the page
caveats: Page says it can be tried free, but details of paid tiers or limits are not shown on the page
Some models are noted as slower, such as GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst with longer generation times
Listing describes the tool as freemium
